title: Legal Battle Over Maple Run District
summary:
*   Officials held a special meeting primarily for a confidential executive session.
*   Discussions included seeking legal advice, potential land acquisitions, personnel issues, and contemplated litigation.
*   A key focus was a potential lawsuit to enforce terms of the Maple Run Municipal Utility District #11 Consent Agreement.
*   No final decisions or public votes were taken during this brief session.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - January 30, 1992
OFFICE OF THE MAYOR - lit00 A.M.
Mayor Todd called to order the Special Called Meeting of the Council, noting the absence
of Mayor Pro Tern Urdy, Councllmembers Garcia and Nofziger.
EXECUTIVE SESSION
Mayor Todd announced that Council would enter into Executive Session, pursuant to Article
6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated, to receive advice from Legal Counsel, to
discuss matters of land acquisition, litigation and personnel natters. No final action,
decision or vote by the City Council will be taken on any subject or matter unless
specifically listed on the agenda for this meeting.
Pending/Contemplated Litigation - Section 2, Paragraph e 1.
Discussion of contemplated litigation to enforce certain terms and provisions of the Maple
Run Municipal Utility District 11 Consent Agreement.
RECESS AND ADJOURNMENT
Council recessed its meeting at 11:03 and adjourned at 11:34 A.M. MINUTES
